text:
Asha: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: landed gw-auth policy v2, added default retry header. Blockers: still seeing sporadic 429s on /v1/chat (staging) that I can't reproduce locally. Today: investigate batching window and add metrics. cc @Liam

Liam: Nice. Re: 429s — I saw similar spikes last night tied to bursty short tokens. Can you paste the logs? :eyes:

Asha: pasted log snippet: ```ERROR 2026-03-18 gateway: route=chat path=/v1/chat status=429 reason=quota_burst token_count=12``` Not sure if it's quota or token-bucket config.

Diego: I'm on the rate-limiter queue today. I can repro with synthetic load. Could be token-bucket leak when route priority shifts. I'll run a reconciler job against staging.

Priya: FYI I merged a config change that reduces max_burst from 20 -> 8 for auth-proxied routes — could be related. PR #4823

Liam: PR link? might explain. Also check KV cache TTLs — we had a race where a stale policy caused higher cost path.

Asha: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/4823

deploy-bot: deploy queued for staging (sha: d3f4a1) — will run smoke tests.

Diego: Repro steps I'm running: `wrk -t4 -c200 -d30s --scripting ~/scripts/chat-burst.lua http://staging-gw/v1/chat` — initial run shows 5-7% 429s.

Asha: Blocker update: I've instrumented the batching window; added metrics to show batch size distribution. Will look at deploy results.

Liam: I'm going to double-check routing policy fallback rules — especially `route.priority` when auth falls back to token validation. Found a minor ordering bug in policy-evaluator.

Priya: No blockers from security side. If Diego confirms it's burst config, we can roll back or tweak config via console.

Asha: Today I'll follow up with Diego and add canary config to reduce burst on traffic shaping. If we need to rollback the v2 auth policy, I'll call it.

Diego: Will post results in ~45m. If I confirm, I'll open an issue with reproducer and a suggested fix.

Liam: :thumbsup: ping me if you want pairing for the fix.

Asha: thanks. Anyone else on call? otherwise I'll close the loop once Diego posts.

Priya: :raised_hands: good plan.
